projects.notes: Weak source. Hosted on a consultant's ArcGIS Online account (item 'INDOT STIP (2024)', modified 2025-12-03), not by INDOT. Only DES number, route, location, WORKTYPE letter code and WORKDESC (154 distinct values; 20 listed); no cost, phase or letting date. All STIP entries are programmed work. INDOT's own server (https://gis.indot.in.gov/ro/rest/services, e.g. DOT/INDOT_NLRI_DATA/MapServer for Next Level Roads) answered HTTP 403 to every request, so nothing there could be verified.
